results.english: Three names in the heavens, you were clothed in, O beholder of God the Evangelist, St. Mark the Apostle.
results.old: Three names in the heavens, you were clothed in, O beholder of God the Evangelist, St. Mark the Apostle.
results.perChannel: Three names in the heavens, you have borne, the beholder of God the Evangelist, Abba Mark the Apostle.

results.old: The mercy seat, which is covered by the Cherubim, is a symbol.

results.english: The patriarchs bless you, the prophets glorify you, we also worship You, O our Lord Jesus Christ.
results.old: The patriarchs bless You, the prophets glorify You, and we worship You. O our Master, the Beginning of the Ages, the Beginning of the Ages.
results.perChannel: The patriarchs bless You, the prophets glorify You, and we worship You O our Master, Jesus Christ, Christ Christ Christ, Christ Jesus our Lord.

results.old: You are blessed and honored, in heaven and on earth, O our true God, our Lord Jesus Christ.
results.perChannel: Blessed and honored in heaven and on earth, O our true God, our Lord Jesus Christ.

results.english: We the Christian people, for He is our true God.
results.old: We, the Christian people, for He is our true God.
results.perChannel: We are Christian peoples, for He is our true God.

results.english: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.
results.old: Remembering therefore the faith which is in thee without hypocrisy, which dwelt first in thy mother Lois, and thy mother Eunice, and am persuaded that God was with thee also.
results.perChannel: Remembering therefore the faith which was in thee without hypocrisy, the which dwelt at home in the mother of thy mother Lōdē, and in Ænikē, being persuaded that it abode with thee also.
